title: The Karnataka Medical Registration and Certain Other Law (Amendment) Bill, 2024
summary: 'The Karnataka Medical Registration and Certain Other Law (Amendment) Bill, 2024' (Bill No. 37 of 2024) is a State legislative measure introduced in the Karnataka Legislative Assembly (Vidhan Sabha) concerning Other / Unclassified. The bill introduces statutory amendments to existing state legislation, primarily modifying Amendment of the Karnataka Act across 3 identified sections/clauses.
